card.text: TOI-1452 b crosses TOI-1452 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.

sources.quote: TOI-1452 b is a confirmed super-Earth exoplanet, possibly a water world, orbiting a red dwarf star TOI-1452 about 100 light-years away in the Draco constellation.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Cadieux et al. 2022.
